en: Colorized photograph showing a stone fortress building seen through a dark archway in the foreground. A cobbled path and gravel road lead uphill toward a thick stone wall with a gate and a rectangular, rough-hewn stone building topped with a greenish metal roof and small belfry-like turret. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and low greenery lines the path. No printed text is visible on the image side.
